welcome_lead: A starter for TypeScript products on Effect v4: an API and a React app on one Cloudflare Worker, Postgres on Neon, and the lint rules, hooks and checks that keep the code in shape as it grows.
welcome_inside_effect_body: HttpApi and RPC over one contract in packages/domain, typed errors, services and layers you can test.
welcome_inside_worker_body: The API Worker serves this app too. Alchemy deploys it with Neon and Hyperdrive in one stack.
welcome_inside_data_body: Neon in production, Docker locally, Testcontainers in tests. No in-memory fakes.
welcome_inside_web_body: React Router, TanStack Query, forms validated with Effect Schema, Tailwind and shadcn.
welcome_inside_guards_body: Custom oxlint rules, Effect diagnostics, Git hooks and a CI that stops at the first failing step.
welcome_inside_agents_body: AGENTS.md, skills and checks that turn a review comment into a rule, so the same mistake does not come back.
welcome_quickstart_body: pnpm dev starts Postgres, the Worker and this app on ports picked for your checkout. pnpm verify runs what CI runs.
